projects.name: Personal affiliate-marketing tracking and optimization platform
projects.summary: Self-developed platform supporting funnel management, click tracking and reporting for hobby-level CPA marketing/traffic arbitrage, with SSP integrations for impression and cost accuracy. Explored ML regression forecasts and a modified DQN agent for automated funnel optimization. Owner clarifies that the modified DQN work used TorchSharp and was experimental rather than production-quality. Delayed rewards made the approach unsuitable for the particular optimization task; switched to a conventional deep neural network without online learning. The replacement neural network used primarily GEO and device attributes to select routing through own landing pages versus directly to the advertiser. It was used on real paid traffic and periodically retrained on all available data.
projects.role: Independent builder and affiliate marketer (owner-reported on LinkedIn)
outcomes: Identified delayed rewards as a practical limitation of the experimental RL approach and switched to a conventional deep neural network without online learning.

After more than 1,000 leads, direct-to-advertiser routing was observed to be more profitable; owner concluded the neural network was unnecessary for this task. No profit amounts, uplift, controlled comparison design or statistical significance supplied.
